subject: Chemistry
basis: JEE Main Chemistry syllabus (JEE_Chem_Syllabus.pdf), 20 units. Cross-checked against
731 JEE Chemistry PYQs in the bank, split by year.
The 2023-24 rationalisation is visible in the papers, not just the document: seven
chapters have questions ONLY in 2021 and ZERO since 2023 - Isolation of Elements (14),
Environmental Chemistry (12), Hydrogen (11), Surface Chemistry (9), Polymers (9),
Chemistry in Everyday Life (7), Solid State (4). Each maps to a unit that no longer
exists. Bank counts below therefore cite post-2023 activity, since a 2021-only count
would argue for a topic JEE has dropped.

chapters.note: Unit 1 Some Basic Concepts. 26 PYQs, 23 since 2023.

SPLIT CHAPTER. In syllabus: percent composition + empirical/molecular formula and stoichiometry (Unit 1, and again Unit 13), and concentration terms molarity/molality/mole fraction (Unit 5 Solutions). NOT in syllabus: qualitative/quantitative analysis framing, precision/accuracy, significant figures and error analysis (2.1-2.3) - 0 JEE PYQs mention significant figures. The school's 2026-27 plan skips this chapter, which drops the in-syllabus calculation half.

Unit 13 Purification and Characterisation of Organic Compounds names crystallization, sublimation, distillation, differential extraction and chromatography - a near-exact match for this chapter. Live in the papers via the Organic Basic Principles chapter's Purification and Chromatography subtopic. The school's plan skips this chapter; for a JEE-track student that is a real gap.
Unit 2 Atomic Structure. 33 PYQs, 26 since 2023.
Unit 3 Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure. 39 PYQs, 25 since 2023.
Unit 7 Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry.
Unit 9 Classification of Elements and Periodicity. 31 PYQs, 24 since 2023.

JEE has no s-block and no Hydrogen unit; both were removed in the rationalisation (bank Hydrogen: 11 PYQs, all 2021, 0 since 2023). The 2 post-2023 rows filed under 'The s-Block Elements' are qualitative SALT ANALYSIS (flame test, Ba2+/Ca2+ precipitation) belonging to Unit 20 Practical Chemistry, not s-block element chemistry - and this chapter does not teach salt analysis.

Unit 10 p-Block covers Groups 13-18 but only as 'general trends across periods and down groups, unique behaviour of the first element'. Post-2023 papers match that scope (group-13 ionic radii, group-15 hydride trends). This chapter's detailed compound chemistry - borax, silicones, diborane, HNO3, H3BO3 - exceeds the stated syllabus.
States of Matter was removed from the JEE syllabus - there is no unit for it, and the bank holds no JEE States-of-Matter chapter at all.

Surface Chemistry was removed as a unit (9 PYQs, all 2021, 0 since 2023). One narrow hook survives: Unit 20 Practical Chemistry names 'preparation of lyophilic and lyophobic sols', which this chapter does teach (12/10 mentions). Everything else here - adsorption isotherms, catalysis, coagulation - is out.
Unit 6 Equilibrium covers the chemical-equilibrium half. 29 PYQs, 26 since 2023. In JEE syllabus but NOT in the CET Std XI list - the two exams differ here.
No nuclear-chemistry or radioactivity unit in the JEE syllabus, and no such chapter in the JEE bank.
Unit 14 Some Basic Principles of Organic Chemistry. 42 PYQs, 34 since 2023.
Unit 15 Hydrocarbons. 43 PYQs, 32 since 2023.
Chemistry in Everyday Life was removed (7 PYQs, all 2021, 0 since 2023).
Solid State was removed from the JEE syllabus (4 PYQs, all 2021, 0 since 2023). Still fully in CET.
Unit 5 Solutions. 24 PYQs, 22 since 2023.
Unit 6 Equilibrium, ionic-equilibrium half - acids/bases, pH, buffers, Ksp, salt hydrolysis.
Unit 4 Chemical Thermodynamics. 23 PYQs, 22 since 2023.
Unit 7 Redox and Electrochemistry. 23 PYQs, 21 since 2023.
Unit 8 Chemical Kinetics. 27 PYQs, 26 since 2023.

Unit 10 p-Block is trends-only, as for Std XI Ch.9. Post-2023 papers ask halogen trends (bond dissociation enthalpy, oxidising power) which map; the chapter's deeper compound preparations exceed the stated scope.
Unit 11 d- and f-Block Elements. 40 PYQs, 25 since 2023.
Unit 12 Coordination Compounds - the single largest JEE Chemistry chapter in the bank: 51 PYQs, 36 since 2023.
Unit 16 Organic Compounds Containing Halogens.
Unit 17 Organic Compounds Containing Oxygen - alcohols, phenols, ethers.
Unit 17 Organic Compounds Containing Oxygen - aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids. 37 PYQs, 23 since 2023.
Unit 18 Organic Compounds Containing Nitrogen. 42 PYQs, 28 since 2023.
Unit 19 Biomolecules. 32 PYQs, 21 since 2023.
Polymers was removed from the JEE syllabus (9 PYQs, all 2021, 0 since 2023). Still fully in CET.
No green-chemistry or nanochemistry unit. Environmental Chemistry, its nearest JEE relative, was removed (12 PYQs, all 2021, 0 since 2023). Still fully in CET.
